name: Eden: Discovery
storyline:
The Story

It's 2030 and the world already ended. Rogue AI kicked off a global war that spiraled out of control. A group of survivors escaped on a ship called Eden, hoping to wait it out in space. But Earth's collapse came faster than expected. They had to come back early.

They landed near the Tigris and Euphrates rivers. The area some believe was the original Garden of Eden. Now it's ground zero for rebuilding civilization. Every raid you run is part of that. Gathering resources, fighting for territory, slowly reclaiming a planet that tried to shake humanity off for good. The lore runs deep, and the world keeps expanding.
summary: Eden: Discovery is a post-apocalyptic free-for-all extraction shooter where 10 players enter a dangerous wasteland, each armed with a primary and secondary weapon. Your goal is simple: loot and reach an extraction point before time runs out - or risk losing everything you carry. Players can scavenge gear from crates, defeat AI threats guarding valuable supplies, or take down rival players to claim their loot. If you’re killed, all your equipment drops, and your killer can pick it up. Multiple players can extract and win if they survive; in some matches, no one makes it out alive.
